title: Lesson cards
description: The five audio-lesson rows on the Media hub. A section header (eyebrow + title + lede) followed by a numbered <ol class="lessons-cards"> of bozzies/lesson-card children. Renders Astro's exact <section class="section ground-paper lessons-grid"> DOM.

attributes.title: Five keys to the Boswell sound
attributes.lede: Cynthia Lucas, one of the best-known Boz historians, narrates five audio lessons that unpack how the Sisters actually did what they did.

attributes.title: The Blend
attributes.summary: Three sisters singing so closely blended they sometimes read as one voice.

attributes.title: The Tempo
attributes.summary: Signature four-to-five tempo shifts within a single arrangement.

attributes.title: The Riffs
attributes.summary: Instrumental-style rhythmic figures the Boswells pulled off with their voices.
